# Deck, white paper and diagram layouts (how ours are built, and the rules for new ones)

All facts about our files [VERIFIED: opened 31 Oct 2026] at `origin/pitch-deck` @ `ad15acb` and
`origin/whitepaper` @ `827a0ec`. Rules marked "ours" are house decisions, not external facts.

## 1. Decks (pitch deck, 10-slide deck, mentor briefs)

**Build, never hand-edit.** Decks are generated by python-pptx from code so every slide stays on the
system: `pitch/src/deck_style.py` (palette, helpers), `build_deck.py` (17-slide), `build_deck10.py`
(10 + 2 backup), `build_brief.py` / `build_brief6.py` (mentor briefs). Icons from `icons.cjs`,
illustrations from `illustrations.cjs`, product screenshots from `capture_shots.py` (the real app in
demo mode). Rebuild commands: `pitch/README.md`. Rendered PNGs + contact sheets live in
`pitch/slides*/` and `*_contact_sheet.png`; the honesty review in `pitch/checks/honesty_review.md`.

**Grid (from `deck_style.py`):** 13.333 × 7.5 in (16:9), outer margin 0.6 in, title at y 0.5 in
(36pt bold, white), optional subtitle at y 1.38 in (20pt, MUTED), footer/sources at H − 0.5 in (10pt,
FAINT; `build_deck10.py` puts sources + marker key at H − 0.62). Ink background on every slide. Cards:
rounded rectangle, CARD fill, 1pt LINE border, no shadow. Pills: INK fill, coloured 1pt outline.

**Rules for new slides (ours, from how `build_deck10.py` is written):**
- One idea per slide; the headline is a full-sentence takeaway; ~30 words on the slide; everything
  else in the speaker notes ("SAY:", "LABELS:", sources).
- Honesty markers on the slide: ◦ estimate or assumption, † untested guess, unmarked = sourced; the
  key in every footer; full [VERIFIED]/[ASSUMPTION]/[GUESS] labels in the notes.
- Real product screenshots only (from `capture_shots.py`, demo data, labelled). No stock imagery,
  no logos of companies that haven't agreed, no customer quotes (the INV-1043 quote on the problem
  slide is labelled illustrative).
- Minimum type 10pt for sources (FAINT on INK 4.72:1 passes); body ≥ 18pt so it reads when shared
  as a PDF on a phone. FAINT on CARD is 4.26:1: use MUTED inside cards (A7).
- Projector check: the deck is dark; a dim projector loses MUTED on CARD first. Check the contact
  sheet at 50% brightness [ASSUMPTION: house practice].
- Check: render to PNG (LibreOffice headless, as the existing contact sheets were made
  [ASSUMPTION: tool inferred from the PNG pipeline, confirm in `pitch/README.md` before relying]),
  view the contact sheet, then each slide at 100%.

## 2. White paper

**Build:** `whitepaper/build.py` → pandoc 3 + XeLaTeX with `style.tex`, Inter, A4, margins 20/22/22/22
mm, 10pt, `\linespread{1.08}`, Mermaid (`mmdc`) and hand-drawn SVGs (`diagrams/*.svg` → PDF via
Playwright `svg2pdf.mjs`). Two outputs: clean copy (markers dropped) and **review copy** (markers
`{{V}}`, `{{V:path}}`, `{{A}}`, `{{G}}` printed as coloured tags). Executive summary built the same way.

**Typographic system (style.tex):** title 30/34pt bold with a 36×3pt accent bar above; subtitle 15/19
muted; section 15/19 bold + 0.8pt accent rule; subsection 11.5/15 bold; captions small muted; footnotes
muted ragged-right; tables `\small`, `arraystretch 1.18`; status boxes `accentbg` fill, accent 0.6pt
frame, 3pt radius; footer "Clearline · Working paper v0.2 · <date>" left, page number right, scriptsize muted.

**Rules (ours):** measure ≈ 75-90 characters per line at 10pt on A4 with 22mm margins (fine; don't
widen margins); links must be ≥ 4.5:1 (current `#6e7df0` is 3.59:1: A6); every figure has a caption
that states the takeaway; every number in a figure carries its label in the review copy; tagged PDF
and alt text for figures where the toolchain allows [ASSUMPTION: XeLaTeX tagging support is limited;
check before promising an accessible PDF].

## 3. Diagrams and mind maps

**Our diagram style (from `whitepaper/diagrams/architecture.svg`):** Inter 12-15px; ink `#0a0c11`
for labels, `#5b6272` for secondary labels, accent `#6e7df0` for the main path, `#a3abba` for
secondary lines, light fills `#f4f5f8` / `#f7f8ff`, green `#2f7d5b` + `#eaf7f0` only for "verified /
passed". Hand-written SVG, not a diagram tool's default theme.

**Rules (ours):**
- Show the real mechanism (what reads what, where a person approves), not a generic hub-and-spoke.
- Arrows and lines that carry meaning ≥ 3:1 against the fill (1.4.11); text ≥ 4.5:1.
- Never colour alone: a "blocked" path is red **and** dashed **and** labelled.
- Mind maps: one central question, ≤ 7 branches, ≤ 2 levels on the page; everything else goes in
  notes. Left-to-right reading order; the approval step ("a person approves") always visible.
- Export SVG (for the site/paper) and PNG @2x (for the deck); give the SVG a `<title>` and the
  `<img>` an alt that states the takeaway.
- Dark versions for the deck use deck tokens (INK/CARD/ACC/MUTED), not inverted light colours.

## 4. Website pages (summary; detail in brand-system.md §2)
Container 1152px, 20px phone gutters, 80-96px section rhythm, Eyebrow → SectionTitle → 17px muted
body, real screenshot in a `BrowserFrame` labelled "demo data", one primary CTA ("Book a 15-minute
call") per view. New sections reuse `ui.tsx` components; a new component needs a reason in the PR.
